documents.table:
CREATE TABLE documents (
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_identity TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN source_type='pdf' THEN content_hash ELSE pmid END) STORED NOT NULL, 
	content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_uri TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	content_scope TEXT NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	title_origin TEXT NOT NULL, 
	authors JSONB NOT NULL, 
	publication_date JSONB NOT NULL, 
	journal TEXT, 
	doi TEXT, 
	pmid TEXT, 
	abstract TEXT, 
	text TEXT, 
	ingestion_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	source_units JSONB NOT NULL, 
	ingestion_metadata JSONB, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_documents_source UNIQUE (source_type, source_identity), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_documents_id_source UNIQUE (document_id, source_type), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_source_type CHECK (source_type IN ('pdf','pubmed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_hash CHECK (content_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_text CHECK (btrim(title) <> '' AND btrim(source_uri) <> ''), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_pmid CHECK (pmid IS NULL OR pmid ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_scope CHECK ((source_type='pubmed' AND pmid IS NOT NULL AND content_scope='abstract') OR (source_type='pdf' AND content_scope IN ('extracted_text','full_text'))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_title_origin CHECK ((source_type='pdf' AND title_origin IN ('manual','document_metadata','filename')) OR (source_type='pubmed' AND title_origin IN ('manual','pubmed_metadata'))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_content CHECK ((content_scope='abstract' AND abstract IS NOT NULL AND btrim(abstract)<>'' AND text IS NULL) OR (content_scope<>'abstract' AND text IS NOT NULL AND btrim(text)<>'')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_authors CHECK (jsonb_typeof(authors)='array'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_date CHECK (jsonb_typeof(publication_date)='object'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_units CHECK (jsonb_typeof(source_units)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(source_units)>0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_documents_ingestion_metadata CHECK (ingestion_metadata IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(ingestion_metadata)='object')
)

chunks.table:
CREATE TABLE chunks (
	chunk_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_type TEXT NOT NULL, 
	chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	location_kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER, 
	section TEXT, 
	start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	model_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	model_revision TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tokenizer_revision TEXT NOT NULL, 
	embedding_dimension INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	normalized BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	chunking_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	document_prefix TEXT NOT NULL, 
	token_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chunking_policy JSONB NOT NULL, 
	search_vector TSVECTOR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, text)) STORED NOT NULL, 
	embedding VECTOR(768) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (chunk_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_chunks_document_source FOREIGN KEY(document_id, source_type) REFERENCES documents (document_id, source_type) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_chunks_position UNIQUE (document_id, chunking_version, chunk_index), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_index CHECK (chunk_index > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_text CHECK (btrim(text) <> ''), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_span CHECK (start_offset >= 0 AND end_offset > start_offset AND end_offset - start_offset = char_length(text)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_location CHECK ((source_type='pdf' AND location_kind='pdf_page' AND page IS NOT NULL AND page>0) OR (source_type='pubmed' AND location_kind='abstract' AND page IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_model CHECK (model_id='intfloat/multilingual-e5-base' AND model_revision='d128750597153bb5987e10b1c3493a34e5a4502a' AND tokenizer_revision='d128750597153bb5987e10b1c3493a34e5a4502a' AND embedding_dimension=768 AND normalized IS TRUE AND chunking_version='source-unit-v1' AND document_prefix='passage: '), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_tokens CHECK (max_tokens>0 AND max_tokens<=512 AND token_count>0 AND token_count<=max_tokens), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_policy CHECK (jsonb_typeof(chunking_policy)='object'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chunks_norm CHECK (abs(vector_norm(embedding)-1.0)<=0.0001)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_chunks_search_vector ON chunks USING gin (search_vector)

document_versions.table:
CREATE TABLE document_versions (
	version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, 
	prepared JSONB NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (document_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_document_versions_active ON document_versions (document_id) WHERE is_active

source_aliases.table:
CREATE TABLE source_aliases (
	namespace TEXT NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (namespace, value, document_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (document_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_alias_namespace CHECK (namespace IN ('pmid','doi','pdf_sha256'))
)

source_status_events.table:
CREATE TABLE source_status_events (
	event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	request JSONB NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (document_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_source_event_document UNIQUE (document_id, event_id)
)

source_states.table:
CREATE TABLE source_states (
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evidence JSONB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id, event_id) REFERENCES source_status_events (document_id, event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_status CHECK (status IN ('normal','corrected','retracted','withdrawn','expression_of_concern'))
)
